GeometryWorker uses unmodified cadquery-ocp-novtk 7.9.3.1.1 (Apache-2.0), backed by OCCT 7.9.3 (LGPL-2.1 with the OCCT exception).
Sources and build instructions:
https://github.com/CadQuery/OCP
https://github.com/Open-Cascade-SAS/OCCT/tree/V7_9_3
https://pypi.org/project/cadquery-ocp-novtk/7.9.3.1.1/
Wheel: cadquery_ocp_novtk-7.9.3.1.1-cp314-cp314-win_amd64.whl
SHA256: eabb9e4eceb4d44b1555981aec8821c3b133300ed4a3929e4fea4510b6737cd5
The portable package includes geometry-source/geometry_worker.py and GeometryWorker.spec for rebuilding or replacing this isolated worker.
